query: Please implement an activity appointment assistant website for publishing and managing activities. The website should have functionalities for publishing activities, viewing participants, and organizing activities. Users should be able to browse activity lists, make appointments for activities of interest, view their appointment records, and manage their personal information. At the same time, users with corresponding permissions can publish, delete, and modify activities. Initialize the background color with ivory and component color with chocolate.
